topic: AI PMs who can't explain a trade-off to engineers
coreInsight: Describe model and prompt trade-offs with eval results, cost and latency instead of adjectives, because engineers can check a number.

hookVariants.text: Stop saying the new model ‘feels smarter’.
How to win a model debate with engineers.

selectionRationale: Highest total (23/25): readable at a glance, and the reel flips each vague claim into a checkable one.

script.onScreen: Engineers don’t trust adjectives. / Bring numbers they can check.
WHAT PMS SAY / Adjectives, not evidence. / VAGUE “It feels smarter” · VAGUE “Quality is way better” · VAGUE “It’s worth the cost”
script.voiceover: What PMs say: it feels smarter. Quality is way better. It’s worth the cost.

script.onScreen: WHAT TO SAY · ILLUSTRATIVE / Numbers they can check. / EVAL +6 passes on our 50-case set · EVAL Wins 31 of 50 blind pairs · PRICE 2x cost per task, +0.8s wait
script.voiceover: What to say instead, illustrative numbers: six more passes on our fifty-case set. Wins thirty-one of fifty blind comparisons. And the price: twice the cost per task and almost a second more wait.

script.onScreen: Name the gain and the price in numbers. / Share this with a PM pitching models
script.voiceover: Name the gain and the price, in numbers. Share this with a PM pitching models.

caption:
“It feels smarter” starts an argument. “+6 passes on our eval set, at 2x the cost” starts a decision.

Swap adjectives for evidence engineers can check:
→ eval pass rate on a fixed set
→ blind side-by-side wins
→ cost per task and added latency

Always say both sides: the gain and the price. (The numbers in the reel are illustrative.)

Share this with a PM pitching models.

#AIProductManager #ProductManagement #AICareers #LLMEvaluation

primaryCta.text: Share this with a PM pitching models

sourcesNote: No time-sensitive or third-party factual claims; practitioner opinion and labelled illustrative numbers only.

claims.text: PMs communicate AI trade-offs more effectively with eval results, cost and latency than with qualitative descriptions.
+6 passes on a 50-case set; 31 of 50 blind wins; 2x cost per task; +0.8s latency.

items: Watch the full MP4 at normal speed on a phone (pacing, readability, transitions).
Listen to the final audio on headphones and a phone speaker (mix, no harshness).
Read the caption once more in Instagram's composer before posting.
